title: Simple Orbital Wolf Cannon
description: Summon a pack of buffed tamed wolves on top of you with a fishing rod as seen in Flamefrags' Unstable SMP videos.
body:
# Orbital Wolf Cannon

Summon a pack of buffed tamed wolves on top of you with a fishing rod.

Inspired by FlameFrags' Unstable SMP videos.

## How it works

Run the command:

```
/orbitalstrike wolf <rodCount> <wolfCount>
```

This gives you some fishing rods. Each rod has 1 durability and is tagged with a wolf
count. Right-click a rod and that many wolves spawn at your feet, all owned by you,
and the rod breaks.

You can run the command multiple times with different counts so you have a stack of
rods loaded with different wolf counts.

Plain 1-durability fishing rods that were not given by the command will not fire the
cannon. Only command-given rods are recognised.

Every wolf spawned:

- is tamed to you
- wears Wolf Armor
- has Speed II for 1:30
- has Strength II for 1:30
- has Fire Resistance for 3:00
- is invulnerable for the first 5 seconds so the entity-cramming damage rule does not
  kill the pack on tick one
- targets whatever you most recently hit; after the 5 second window vanilla owner-target
  AI takes over

## Loaders

- NeoForge
- Fabric
- Quilt (loads the Fabric jar directly)

## Minecraft versions

- 1.21 through 1.21.11
- 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2

## Installation

1. Install your loader for the matching Minecraft version.
2. Drop the matching jar into your `mods/` folder.
3. Test in creative before turning it loose on a server.
